name: Rise of the Silithid
summary: In Darnassus, a copy of Raschal's account is bound for Gracina Spiritmight. General Shandris Feathermoon gives it to you, trusting the priestess's knowledge of such creatures.

sections.title: A Copy for the Protectorate
sections.body: General Shandris Feathermoon entrusts you with a copy of Raschal's account for Gracina Spiritmight, an associate of the Protectorate. The main report has been filed in Darnassus, where Gracina lives as a priestess in the Temple of the Moon. Shandris believes her broad knowledge of such creatures will benefit everyone who receives the account. She sends you on with good wishes and a prayer that Elune watch over all.

sections.title: What the Priestess Knows
sections.body: Gracina Spiritmight welcomes you to the blessed Temple of the Moon. The night elves already know the terror Raschal describes, she says. Silithid will consume Feralas swiftly and rank among the greatest menaces anyone will face. Yet they are only tools of one of the gravest threats the Horde and the Alliance will ever face. Gracina prays that resolve will be found to defeat them before they destroy us.

faq.q: Who sends you to Darnassus with this report?

faq.answer: General Shandris Feathermoon gives you a copy of Raschal's account for Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

Gracina Spiritmight is a priestess who lives in Darnassus's Temple of the Moon. Shandris Feathermoon calls her an associate of the Protectorate with broad knowledge of the creatures in Raschal's account.
Raschal's account tells of the infestation in southeastern Feralas.

aliases: what quest comes before rise of the silithid
faq.answer: This follows A Hero's Welcome, where you met General Feathermoon at the Stronghold.
